description: Designs levels and encounters: spatial layout, pacing, difficulty curve across a level, enemy and reward placement, teaching order. Produces level plans and beat sheets, not the built level.
when_to_use: a level, stage, map or encounter has to be laid out
the moment-to-moment pacing of a level is wrong
new mechanics need a place that teaches them
avoid_when: the request is to tune global numbers rather than one level's shape
